capabilities: Upload and download file changes between devices
Propagate file deletions in both directions
Preserve local conflict copies on two-sided changes
Run automatic synchronization at a configurable interval
Exclude .obsidian settings and plugin data from sync
extras: Early release with explicit warnings to back up the vault before first sync; each user must register their own Microsoft Entra app and enter its client ID; files up to 250 MB supported.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service, and the plugin offers OneDrive-based cross-device syncing without the OneDrive desktop client.

requires.name: Microsoft Entra application registration by the user

summary: Sync plugin that synchronizes vault files across devices via a private OneDrive app folder using Microsoft Graph directly.
